instances.claim: This tells me that Chang produced a fixed, countable group of Cent objects that started out the same as each other and have since diverged through handling.
instances.why: Both 'Every Cent' and 'Each object, initially identical' quantify over a bounded collection of the work's own objects with fixed membership, and no line introduces one — line 5 names a kind of thing (a readymade) and line 6 counts all Lincoln cents ever minted, which is the mint's population, not Chang's. Without that set the population claims ('every', 'each', 'initially identical') have nothing to range over, so the five-transformation structure and the divergence-through-touch claim both rest on a group the draft never put on screen.
